```yaml
name: Test BPFtrace

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test-helloworld:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        profile: minimal
        components: rustfmt

    - name: Build helloworld project in debug mode
      run: cargo build --manifest-path helloworld/Cargo.toml --debug

    - name: Verify hello function symbol exists in debug build
      run: nm helloworld/target/debug/helloworld | grep ' T _ZN10helloworld5helloE'

    - name: Test helloworld binary execution
      run: ./helloworld/target/debug/helloworld

  build-and-test-args:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        profile: minimal
        components: rustfmt

    - name: Build args project in debug mode
      run: cargo build --manifest-path args/Cargo.toml --debug

    - name: Verify hello function symbol exists in debug build
      run: nm args/target/debug/args | grep ' T _ZN10helloworld5helloE'

    - name: Test args binary execution
      run: ./args/target/debug/args

  bpftrace-attach-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        profile: minimal
        components: rustfmt

    - name: Build helloworld project in debug mode
      run: cargo build --manifest-path helloworld/Cargo.toml --debug

    - name: Install bpftrace
      run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y bpftrace

    - name: Attach bpftrace to helloworld binary with wildcard pattern
      run: sudo bpftrace -e 'attach_function("helloworld", "_ZN10helloworld5hello*", { printf("%s\n", str(arg0)); })' ./helloworld/target/debug/helloworld

    - name: Verify bpftrace captures function calls
      run: echo $?
```
